name_input: VGROWN TECH PRIVATE LIMITED( of Kira Diam LLP)
export_evidence: ImportKey, VGROWN TECH PRIVATE LIMITED (PLOT NO. 1, SHANTI NIKETAN SOCIETY, VIBHAG-2, LAJAMANI CHOWK, MOTA VARACHHA — Surat diamond cluster): "Total Shipments 64313 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-01-15". Exact row: "2026-01-08 | VGROWN TECH PRIVATE LIMITED | ZNZ JEWELS FZCO | LAB GROWN CUT AND POLISHED DIAMONDS CVD AS PER PACKING LIST WITH IGI CERTIFICATE | SDB Diamond Bourse INSTV4, India | DUBAI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 71049120 | BOL 8574683". Further rows: 2026-01-07 → KIRA DIAM HK LIMITED, HONG KONG, HS 71049120, BOL 8538983; 2026-01-06 → DAVID OUALID LTD, TEL AVIV YAFO, Israel, HS 71049120, BOL 8512286; 2026-01-09 → ECO GROW FZC, DUBAI UAE, HS 71049110, BOL 8606150. Import side: 2026-01-15 VASU GEMS FZCO → VGROWN TECH, HS 71042120, BOL 6904828. Source counter: page states 64,313 total shipments; 5 individual rows actually rendered in the free view.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record retrieved — the web_search backend returned "Connection refused" on all queries, so no domestic-supply source could be read. Not public in the sources consulted; recorded as null rather than inferred.
note: Legal entity in the customs records is VGROWN TECH PRIVATE LIMITED, not the claimed "KIRA DIAM TECH PRIVATE LIMITED" — the two are separate Surat entities that share the same registered address (Plot No. 1, Shanti Niketan Society, Mota Varachha) and the same related-party buyers (KIRA JEWELS INC, KIRA DIAM HK LIMITED, MD SONS HK LIMITED), i.e. group companies of Kira Diam LLP. Declared HS 710491 matches the actual shipment HS 71049120 (lab-grown cut & polished diamonds) — no HS correction needed. Industry claim "Продукты питания и FMCG" is wrong: actual activity is lab-grown diamond (CVD) manufacturing and export, plus import of rough CVD. Export shipments are factual, dated and B/L-numbered. Domestic supply evidence not found in accessible sources — not asserted either way.
